title: Teaching the Qur'an: planning a mini lesson: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: Understanding the Qur'an and teaching
source: Written for quran/y11 lesson 7 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Teaching the Qur'an rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 7. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

panels.title: A great reward and a trust
points: Teach only what you know well

head: Part
What you do
Time
rows: One question to make them curious
Say the rule; model one example
Learner finds and reads one alone

questions.q: Plan the 'I do' for idgham shafawi with «رَبِّهِم مِّن» (97:4).
questions.a: Rule: meem sakinah before meem merges with a two-count ghunnah; model: rabbihim-min, humming two counts.

questions.q: Planning frame (pupil PDF): plan an 8-minute mini lesson on one rule for a Year 3 to 5 learner, with your example from a short surah. Today's rota group recites Juz' Tabarak (Al-Mulk 67:1 to 15).
questions.a: A complete five-part plan with an accurate rule, a real example and a kind correction line.

questions.q: Extend: write two likely mistakes and how you would correct each.
questions.a: For example: no hum: 'Listen to the hum: two counts'; hiding the meem before و: 'Izhar: say the meem clearly before و'.

questions.q: In a mini lesson, 'we do' means ...
options: the learner echoes and practises with you
questions.a: A) the learner echoes and practises with you. Guided practice: learner and teacher together.

questions.q: The first priority in teaching the Qur'an is ...
Think again: Think of the best Qur'an teacher you have had. What did they do that helped you most?
questions.a: Patience, clear examples, correcting one thing at a time, praise, and making du'a for us.
